title: 3 Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stocks to Load Up On in August
excerpt: There are several promising AI stocks to buy right now.
content_html:
August has just begun, but the events in late July and early August have really shaken up the artificial intelligence (AI) investing landscape. Several winners and losers have appeared, and even though earnings season isn't over yet, there are plenty of stocks worth considering right now.

A few stocks that top my list are Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA), Micron (NASDAQ: MU), and Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN). All three of these look like great AI options now and are worth buying at these levels.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

1. Nvidia

Nvidia hasn't been the Nvidia most people remember in 2026. For the previous three years, it was one of the top stocks in the market to own. This year, it has risen around 17%, which is just barely better than the S&P 500 (SNPINDEX: ^GSPC). However, that could change shortly.

Nvidia reports its fiscal second quarter results at the end of August, and there have been several indications that it could be a blowout quarter. Many AI hyperscalers have raised spending guidance, and one of Nvidia's chief competitors, AMD, reported a blowout quarter. Unlike AMD, Nvidia's stock isn't highly valued heading into earnings, and that could be a recipe for the stock to explode higher.

Nvidia trades for a pretty reasonable price tag of 24 times forward earnings. You'll be hard-pressed to find a stock growing as fast at that cheap of a price, and I think it's primed to skyrocket late in August following earnings.

2. Micron

Micron is having a great 2026, with the stock more than tripling. However, it's well off its all-time high due to skepticism about the longevity of the memory chip price boom.

Micron makes memory chips, which have become a major bottleneck in the AI build-out. When supply is low and demand is high, prices soar. This benefits companies like Micron, and its earnings and profits have soared as a result. Still, this won't last forever, and the market is worried that prices could fall in the near future.

However, Micron's management team doesn't believe that to be the case. Because it will be mid-2027 before more production capacity is available, they believe the tightness in the memory chip market will persist beyond 2027. That leaves plenty of room for prices to stay elevated, and for Micron to succeed.

As a result, I think Micron is a solid stock to buy on the dip, as the market will eventually come back around to buying this major winner.

1. 英伟达

2026 年，Nvidia 不再是大多数人记忆中的 Nvidia。 在过去的三年里，它是市场上最值得持有的股票之一。 今年，该指数上涨了 17% 左右，仅略高于标准普尔 500 指数（SNPINDEX：^GSPC）。 然而，这种情况可能很快就会改变。

英伟达于八月底公布了第二财季业绩，有多种迹象表明该季度可能会出现井喷。 许多人工智能超大规模公司都提高了支出指引，英伟达的主要竞争对手之一AMD报告了井喷的季度业绩。 与 AMD 不同，英伟达的股票在进入盈利阶段时估值并不高，这可能是该股飙升的一个秘诀。

Nvidia 的交易价格相当合理，是预期市盈率的 24 倍。 你很难找到一只股票能以如此便宜的价格增长得如此之快，而且我认为它在盈利后将在八月底飙升。

2. 微米

美光科技 2026 年的表现非常出色，其股价增长了两倍多。 然而，由于人们对存储芯片价格繁荣的持续时间持怀疑态度，该价格远低于历史最高点。

美光生产内存芯片，这已成为人工智能发展的主要瓶颈。 当供应量低而需求量大时，价格就会飙升。 这有利于像美光这样的公司，其收益和利润也因此飙升。 不过，这种情况不会永远持续下去，市场担心价格在不久的将来可能会下跌。

然而，美光的管理团队并不认为事实如此。 由于要到 2027 年中期才会有更多产能，因此他们认为存储芯片市场的紧张状况将持续到 2027 年之后。 这为价格保持高位以及美光的成功留下了足够的空间。

因此，我认为美光科技是一只值得在下跌时买入的可靠股票，因为市场最终会回过头来买入这只主要赢家。
